question: Do the four ARC-036 hippocampal valence dimensions (wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, surprise) encode separably on the REAL ree_core/residue/field.py RBFLayer/ResidueField substrate (not EXQ-176's disconnected, never-trained inline reimplementation)?
decisive_readout: channel_spearman (full 6-pair matrix), mean_pairwise_tau_dissociated, mean_pairwise_topk_jaccard -- read via ResidueField.evaluate_valence / get_valence_priority over a real REEAgent rollout with all four SD-014 write paths driven every step

answer.instrument: REEAgent + ree_core/residue/field.py RBFLayer/ResidueField (real production substrate, NOT EXQ-176's disconnected inline reimplementation). All four SD-014/ARC-036 write paths driven every waking step (update_benefit_salience->WANTING, update_liking->LIKING, update_harm_salience->HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE, update_residue->SURPRISE); readout via ResidueField.evaluate_valence (representational, stored per-node vector) and get_valence_priority (functional, replay-priority ranking).

V3-EXQ-887a.config: incentive_sensitization enabled, DEFAULT gain (rate=0.05 max=4.0 coupling=1.0)
V3-EXQ-887a.gate: green; seed 2026 passed C1+C2+C3, seeds 42/137 missed narrowly

V3-EXQ-887b.config: incentive_sensitization enabled, ABOVE-DEFAULT gain (rate=0.10 max=8.0 coupling=2.5)

arc036_four_dimension_pairwise_spearman.note: |Spearman| of the STORED per-node valence vector between each pair of the four ARC-036 dimensions (wanting/liking/harm_discriminative/surprise), across all 3 seeds x 3 runs (9 readings per pair). Lower = more dissociated/separable.

wanting|liking.trend: falls below the 0.90 SD-014 threshold ONLY at 887b's above-default sensitization gain; at 887/887a's default or no gain it exceeds 0.90 on 8 of 9 seed-runs

harm_discriminative|surprise.trend: IDENTICAL across all three runs/configs for the corresponding seed -- the sensitization gain only touches the WANTING write path, so this pair is a gain-independent, replicated (9/9 seed-runs) reading of substantial residual correlation between harm-discriminative and surprise. This is the pair ARC-036's own dissociation claim is weakest on.

liking|harm_discriminative.trend: IDENTICAL across all three runs (liking/harm writes untouched by sensitization gain) -- the cleanest-dissociating pair of the six on the low-correlation seeds, but still 0.73 on seed 137/2026

liking|surprise.trend: IDENTICAL across all three runs -- consistently the LOWEST-correlated (most cleanly dissociated) pair of the six

mean_pairwise_kendall_tau_across_4_drive.interpretation: well under the 0.85 ceiling on 887b; drive-state genuinely re-ranks replay priority across the four dimensions

mean_pairwise_topk5_jaccard_across_4_dri.interpretation: well under the 0.80 ceiling; replay-priority top-5 sets are drive-selective, not a fixed set

method_note: Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1 check (queue-experiment skill) found the decisive readout ARC-036's own probe would need is ALREADY recorded on the real substrate in the SD-014 V3-EXQ-887/887a/887b family (887b readiness gate green, all 3 seeds), so no new run was queued. Re-read the already-recorded per-seed channel_spearman across all 6 valence-channel pairs (not just SD-014's own wanting|liking focus) from all three manifests in that lineage and applied ARC-036's own 4-dimension separability framing to it.
notes: Corrects the EXQ-176 misdiagnosis already flagged in claims.yaml (EXQ-176 used a standalone RBFLayer with fixed, never-trained random centers -- disconnected from the real substrate -- so its 2026-03-30 FAIL never actually tested ARC-036 against production code). This reanalysis is the first real-substrate touchpoint for ARC-036's own claim_ids. Finding is genuinely MIXED, not a clean supports: (1) all four channels write and populate on the real substrate (readiness gate green); (2) wanting|liking separates only once SD-014's incentive-sensitization write-path is enabled at an ABOVE-DEFAULT gain (887b) -- at default/no gain (887/887a) it exceeds the 0.90 dissociation ceiling on 8 of 9 seed-runs, so that pair's separability is CONDITIONAL on a specific mechanism tuning, not a substrate default; (3) harm_discriminative|surprise sits at 0.73-0.85 IDENTICALLY across all three configs (gain-independent, 9/9 seed-runs) -- the most robustly-replicated finding here, and it is the pair ARC-036 is weakest on: harm and surprise are NOT cleanly dissociated on this substrate; (4) liking|surprise and liking|harm_discriminative are the most cleanly separable pairs (0.28-0.73), also gain-independent. Functional readout (drive-gated replay re-ranking, top-K jaccard) on 887b is clean.
